notes: External smart-contract audit (R-01) not yet engaged. Every contract in contracts/src is Base Sepolia testnet-only until it clears. Mainnet escrow boot is fenced by composition/escrow-audit-gate.ts (which ALSO requires this file's status to be 'approved'), and check-audit-status.mjs forbids marking 'approved' without an auditor, an audited 40-hex commit, a report reference, and zero unresolved critical/high findings. Approval ALSO binds to the audited build (P1): compiler (solc_version/optimizer_enabled/optimizer_runs/evm_version), contract_source_tree_sha256, and creation/runtime_bytecode_sha256, plus approved_chain_ids and immutable_references. runtime_bytecode_sha256 is the IMMUTABLE-MASKED runtime hash (the immutable_references byte ranges are zeroed before hashing) so the api's mainnet escrow boot fence can compare it against the on-chain eth_getCode result. NOTE: BrainEscrow now has NO immutables (arbiter became a storage variable so it can be rotated two-step), so immutable_references is expected to be an empty list and the masked hash equals the plain runtime hash. Populate these from `node scripts/verify-audited-build.mjs` (run after `forge build`) using the auditor's final report; that tool also re-verifies them in CI so a contract or toolchain change after the audited commit fails the build. Update this file ONLY from the auditor's final report. SCOPE GAP TO CLOSE BEFORE MAINNET: this record covers BrainEscrow only, but BrainSmartAccount custodies tenant ETH and ERC-20 balances and delegates spending authority to session keys, so it is the higher-risk contract and currently has no boot fence, no audit gate, and no deployed-bytecode verification. BrainAuditAnchor, BrainPolicyRegistry, BrainMCPAgentRegistry and BrainReputationRegistry are likewise ungated. FIXED (was ACCEPTED RISK): the audit-anchor root now commits to the leaf COUNT. The tree still duplicates a trailing odd node, so [A,B,C] and [A,B,C,C] fold identically, but every tree carries a synthetic count leaf at index 0 (BrainAuditAnchor.countLeaf, mirrored byte-for-byte by services/audit/src/merkle.ts) so their roots differ and an anchor claiming eventCount = 4 over a 3-event window is no longer indistinguishable from a genuine 4-leaf window. The count leaf is reconstructible on-chain from the stored eventCount, so verifyInclusion proves the count as well as membership. The earlier reason for deferring (it would invalidate every anchor already published on Base Sepolia) does not apply: REDEPLOY-RUNBOOK.md redeploys BrainAuditAnchor with zero carried storage, so there is nothing to preserve. The 0x00/0x01 leaf-vs-internal domain separation is UNCHANGED and still blocks the separate second-preimage case. Cross-language equivalence is pinned by shared vectors in contracts/test/BrainAuditAnchor.t.sol and services/audit/src/merkle.test.ts.
